description: Rebuilds a developer's complete, accurate ownership of work they directed but did not fully author. Especially effective on large or multi-file AI-generated changes where whole regions — and whole code paths — were never in the developer's head. Enumerates every unit of change into a coverage ledger, classifies by risk, and requires the developer to explain high-risk items, and every non-obvious branch through the changed logic, in their own words at mechanism depth. Completeness is counted; accuracy is grounded. Never pretends to block the owner. Use after finishing meaningful AI-assisted work, particularly on systems with invariants, money movement, compliance, or cross-service contracts.
name: recontextualizer
symptom: Developers ship AI-generated changes they directed but cannot explain, especially the branches they never walked.
